hints: Two bugs, both word-splitting: the for f in $(cat manifest) line splits the FILE into words instead of lines, and the mv $f $archive line splits each NAME again if it has a space.

Fix 1 (L2.3 pattern): while IFS= read -r f; do ... done < "$manifest" — reads lines, not words. Fix 2: quote every expansion — mv -- "$f" "$archive"/ — the -- stops a dash-leading name from being read as an option.

Full target shape: set -euo pipefail at the top; while IFS= read -r f; do [[ -n "$f" ]] || continue; mv -- "$f" "$archive"/; done < "$manifest"; echo staged. Then shellcheck stage.sh and lab check bash L3.1.
